_comment: Test vectors for the protocol, version 0. Keys are throwaway, derived as SHA-256 of the phrases below; signatures are BIP-340 with aux_rand = 32 zero bytes, so these vectors are exactly reproducible. For each valid vector: strip sig, serialize per the canonical rules, confirm the bytes match 'canonical', compute the tagged message hash SHA256(SHA256(tag) || SHA256(tag) || bytes) with tag 'ditta/v0/' + message_type, confirm it matches 'sha256', and verify 'sig' over it against 'pubkey'. Invalid vectors are raw JSON text a conformant receiver MUST reject with the code in 'expect', or with one of them where 'expect' lists several.

valid.name: announcement
valid.description: The Appendix A announcement. Nested objects and arrays exercise key sorting at every level while array order is preserved.

valid.name: announcement_unknown_field
valid.description: Announcement carrying a field this document does not define. A receiver MUST ignore the unknown field for routing but MUST include it in the canonical serialization: the signature covers every field except sig, known or not. Discarding it before verifying breaks the signature.

valid.name: announcement_bare_ip
valid.description: Announcement whose endpoint host is a bare IP address with an explicit port. Domains, IPs, and onion addresses are indistinguishable to the protocol.

valid.name: announcement_batch_boundary
valid.description: Announcement whose per_batch option carries a query count of exactly two, the smallest permitted value. A count of one would make the batch a per_query option wearing the wrong type.

valid.name: announcement_nonsense_language_tag
valid.description: Announcement whose languages array carries a string that is not a BCP-47 tag. Language tags are advisory routing input; a receiver MUST NOT reject an announcement for the form of a tag.

valid.name: announcement_key_order_non_ascii
valid.description: Announcement with unknown top-level fields whose keys are U+FFFD and U+1F50D. Rule 3 sorts by UTF-8 byte value, which equals code point order, so the U+FFFD key precedes the U+1F50D key. A serializer sorting by UTF-16 code units - as RFC 8785 (JCS) does - puts the surrogate-pair key first, producing different canonical bytes and a signature that does not verify.

message.�: sorts first in UTF-8 byte order
message.🔍: sorts first in UTF-16 code-unit order

valid.canonical: {"endpoint":"https://198.51.100.7","pricing":[],"protocol_version":0,"pubkey":"b4ad274d8b67c0a509a579091426e719487b8162514a64742f0002aec482976c","roles":["broker"],"timestamp":1787000400,"�":"sorts first in UTF-8 byte order","🔍":"sorts first in UTF-16 code-unit order"}

valid.name: peer_list_request
valid.description: Peer list request. MUST be signed.

valid.name: peer_list_response_unsigned_envelope
valid.description: Peer list response without an envelope signature, which is permitted. The embedded announcement carries its own sig field, which stays inside the envelope's canonical serialization: rule 1 excludes only the envelope's own sig. Each embedded announcement must verify independently.

valid.name: peer_list_response_signed_envelope
valid.description: The same peer list response with the optional envelope signature.

valid.name: corpus_statistics_request_no_max
valid.description: Corpus statistics request with the optional max term count absent. Rule 2: absent fields are omitted entirely; this canonical form has no max_terms key.

valid.name: corpus_statistics_response_boundaries
valid.description: Corpus statistics response with boundary integers: a zero freshness marker and a document count of 2^53 - 1, the largest permitted integer. Rule 7: zero is emitted as 0; the maximum is emitted without exponent.

valid.name: query_request_signed
valid.description: Signed query request.

valid.name: query_request_per_batch_signed
valid.description: Signed per_batch query request. A per_batch query MUST be signed so the indexer can bind the batch macaroon to the requester's key, and MUST carry a query count naming the batch option it is buying.

valid.name: query_request_anonymous
valid.description: Anonymous query request: no pubkey, no sig. Unsigned messages still have exactly one canonical serialization; the hash is shown although nothing signs it.

valid.name: query_request_string_escapes
valid.description: Query string exercising every escaping rule at once: a double quote, a backslash, a forward slash (rule 9: never escaped), a tab and newline (rule 8: two-character forms), U+0001 (rule 8: lowercase \u00xx), an accented character and an emoji (rule 10: literal UTF-8, never \u). The request identifier is 64 UTF-8 bytes exactly: 21 three-byte characters and one ASCII byte.

message.query:
he said "p\q" a/b	x
y café 🔍

valid.name: query_request_del_character
valid.description: Query containing a literal U+007F. Rule 8's escaping stops at U+001F; U+007F is emitted literally, never as an escape.

valid.name: result_set_signed
valid.description: Signed result set. Ordering is positional; there is no score field.

results.title: Channel jamming: a survey
results.snippet: Jamming attacks occupy channel capacity without paying…

valid.canonical: {"pubkey":"4af8136ba2e2c7027f55742d1d75b0a03f3388367c139f51ef19420562d129c8","request_id":"q-7719","results":[{"id":"doc-118824","snippet":"Jamming attacks occupy channel capacity without paying…","title":"Channel jamming: a survey","url":"https://example.org/jamming-paper"},{"id":"doc-90211","snippet":"a/b testing of upfront fees","title":"Réponse: mitigations — 対策","url":"https://example.org/café-post"}]}

valid.name: result_set_empty
valid.description: A paid response containing zero results, which is conformant.

valid.name: error_signed
valid.description: Signed error. The pubkey identifies the responder, never the requester.

valid.name: error_unsigned_no_request_id
valid.description: Unsigned error with no request identifier, as sent when the failed request was too malformed to carry one. The pubkey is REQUIRED even unsigned.

valid.name: peer_list_response_embedded_unknown_field
valid.description: Peer list response whose embedded announcement carries an unknown field. Embedded announcements are the one nested exception to the closed-shape rule: each follows announcement rules, including tolerance, because it is an announcement.

valid.name: error_unknown_code
valid.description: Error carrying a code outside the defined list. The code list is soft-closed: a receiver MUST treat an unrecognized code as 'rejected' and SHOULD log it. The message itself is conformant and MUST NOT be rejected.

valid.name: payment_challenge_signed
valid.description: Signed payment challenge: the body of a 402 response. The invoice and macaroon are opaque strings duplicated from the WWW-Authenticate header; the signature binds both to the indexer's protocol identity.

valid.name: announcement_both_roles
valid.description: Announcement declaring both roles. A node MAY declare both; declaring indexer brings the corpus summary and pricing requirements with it.

valid.name: announcement_two_batch_options
valid.description: Announcement advertising two per_batch options at different counts. An indexer MAY advertise several; a query selects one by naming its count.

valid.name: announcement_future_version
valid.description: Announcement declaring a protocol version this document does not define. It validates and its signature verifies, so a node MAY relay it; the same node MUST NOT route on it.

valid.name: peer_list_response_empty
valid.description: Peer list response with an empty peers array, which is conformant: serving the path obliges a node to answer, never to disclose.

valid.name: corpus_statistics_response_duplicate_term
valid.description: Corpus statistics response naming the same term twice. The array MAY repeat a term; the last occurrence governs.

valid.name: query_request_empty_query
valid.description: Query request whose query string is empty. The string MAY be empty; whether it is serviceable is the indexer's policy, not conformance.

valid.name: query_request_zero_max_price
valid.description: Query request whose max price is zero. The max price MAY be zero; an indexer whose price is higher declines with price_exceeded.

valid.name: result_set_unsigned
valid.description: Unsigned result set. Result sets MAY be signed; the pubkey is carried either way.

invalid.name: operational_unknown_field
invalid.reason: Unknown top-level field on an operational message. MUST be rejected; only announcements tolerate unknown fields.

invalid.name: missing_required_field
invalid.reason: Query request without its query field.

invalid.name: integer_as_string
invalid.reason: String-encoded amount. A string where an integer belongs MUST be rejected.

invalid.name: integer_as_string_count
invalid.reason: String-encoded max result count. The rule is not specific to amounts: a string where any integer belongs MUST be rejected.

invalid.name: floating_point
invalid.reason: Floating-point amount. MUST be rejected.

invalid.name: exponent_notation
invalid.reason: Exponent notation. Canonical numbers are plain integers.

invalid.name: integer_too_large
invalid.reason: 2^53, one above the maximum. MUST be rejected; parsers that round it to a double will not even see the correct value.

invalid.name: negative_integer
invalid.reason: Negative integer. Every integer in the protocol is non-negative.

invalid.name: max_results_zero
invalid.reason: Max result count MUST be greater than zero.

invalid.name: max_terms_zero
invalid.reason: Signed corpus statistics request whose max term count is zero. The count, if present, MUST be greater than zero.

invalid.name: max_peers_zero
invalid.reason: Signed peer list request whose max peer count is zero. The count, if present, MUST be greater than zero.

invalid.name: duplicate_key
invalid.reason: Duplicate key. MUST be rejected at parsing rather than letting the parser pick one.

invalid.name: null_optional_field
invalid.reason: Null is not absence. An absent optional field is omitted entirely; null is a wrong type.

invalid.name: uppercase_pubkey
invalid.reason: Uppercase hexadecimal pubkey on an otherwise valid signed query. MUST be rejected.

invalid.name: pubkey_without_sig
invalid.reason: Query carrying a pubkey but no sig. The two fields are all-or-nothing.

invalid.name: sig_without_pubkey
invalid.reason: Query carrying a sig but no pubkey. The two fields are all-or-nothing.

invalid.name: malformed_signature
invalid.reason: Signature that is not 128 hex characters, paired with a well-formed pubkey.

invalid.name: invalid_role
invalid.reason: Role outside the closed list. The roles list is closed for version 0.

invalid.name: invalid_pricing_type
invalid.reason: Pricing type outside the closed list.

invalid.name: query_count_on_per_query
invalid.reason: query_count present on a per_query pricing entry. It belongs to per_batch only.

invalid.name: query_count_absent_on_per_batch
invalid.reason: per_batch pricing entry without query_count.

invalid.name: query_count_on_per_query_request
invalid.reason: Query request naming per_query but carrying a query count. The field travels only with per_batch.

invalid.name: query_count_absent_on_per_batch_request
invalid.reason: Signed per_batch query request without a query count. A per_batch query MUST name the batch option it is buying.

invalid.name: query_count_one_request
invalid.reason: Signed per_batch query request with a query count of one. The count MUST be an integer greater than one.

invalid.name: request_id_empty
invalid.reason: Request identifier below the 1-byte minimum.

invalid.name: request_id_too_long
invalid.reason: Request identifier of 66 UTF-8 bytes (22 three-byte characters). The 64-byte limit is on encoded bytes, not code points: 22 code points, still too long.

invalid.name: query_count_one
invalid.reason: per_batch pricing entry with a query count of one. The count MUST be an integer greater than one.

invalid.name: nesting_too_deep
invalid.reason: 80 nested arrays. Defined shapes never nest this deep; the reference implementation enforces a nesting limit of 64 open containers and rejects deeper input cleanly rather than crashing (too_deep). An implementation enforcing a higher local limit parses this input and rejects it at validation as missing_field, since it carries none of a query request's required fields and a missing required field is reported before an unknown one. Either code passes.

invalid.name: negative_zero
invalid.reason: The literal -0. Every integer is non-negative; -0 is a sign the protocol never permits, not an alternative spelling of zero.

invalid.name: duplicate_key_escaped
invalid.reason: Duplicate key spelled two ways: the second key is 'query' written with an escape. Key equality is judged after escape processing, so this is the duplicate_key case in disguise.

invalid.name: lone_surrogate
invalid.reason: Escape sequence decoding to an unpaired surrogate. Not a Unicode scalar value; MUST be rejected.

invalid.name: corpus_without_indexer
invalid.reason: Broker-only announcement carrying a corpus summary. The summary is present exactly when the roles include indexer.

invalid.name: pricing_without_indexer
invalid.reason: Broker-only announcement carrying a pricing option. A node not declaring indexer MUST carry an empty pricing array.

invalid.name: indexer_empty_pricing
invalid.reason: Indexer announcement with an empty pricing array. An indexer MUST advertise at least one pricing option; free service is a price of 0, not an empty array.

invalid.name: duplicate_role
invalid.reason: The same role declared twice. The roles array MUST NOT repeat a role.

invalid.name: duplicate_pricing_type
invalid.reason: Two per_query options. An announcement MUST NOT carry per_query or per_result more than once.

invalid.name: duplicate_batch_count
invalid.reason: Two per_batch options at the same query count. A query selects a batch option by its count, so two options at one count cannot be told apart.

invalid.name: invalid_signature
invalid.reason: Well-formed announcement whose signature does not verify (final bit flipped). MUST be discarded and MUST NOT be relayed.

invalid.name: uppercase_sig
invalid.reason: Signature in uppercase hexadecimal. MUST be rejected even though the bytes it encodes would verify.

invalid.name: corpus_unknown_field
invalid.reason: Unknown field inside the corpus object. Announcement tolerance applies to top-level fields only; every nested shape is closed.

invalid.name: result_entry_unknown_field
invalid.reason: Unknown field inside a result entry, here a score, which the protocol does not carry. Nested shapes on operational messages are closed.

invalid.name: indexer_without_corpus
invalid.reason: Announcement declaring the indexer role without a corpus summary.

invalid.name: empty_roles
invalid.reason: Announcement declaring no role. A node MUST declare at least one.

invalid.name: announcement_unsigned
invalid.reason: Announcement without a signature. Announcements MUST be signed.

invalid.name: peer_list_request_unsigned
invalid.reason: Peer list request without a signature. Peer list requests MUST be signed.

invalid.name: corpus_statistics_request_unsigned
invalid.reason: Corpus statistics request without a signature. Corpus statistics requests MUST be signed.

invalid.name: corpus_statistics_response_unsigned
invalid.reason: Corpus statistics response without a signature. Corpus statistics responses MUST be signed.

invalid.name: term_entry_unknown_field
invalid.reason: Unknown field inside a statistics term entry. Nested shapes on operational messages are closed; the signature verifying does not save it.

invalid.name: peer_list_response_unknown_field
invalid.reason: Unknown field on a peer list response envelope. Announcement tolerance applies to the embedded announcements, never to the envelope.

invalid.name: not_utf8_bytes
invalid.reason: Query request whose bytes contain 0xFF, which no UTF-8 sequence permits. The input field is hex-encoded because the bytes cannot live in this JSON file; decode it before feeding your parser.

invalid.name: truncated_json
invalid.reason: Bytes that stop before the JSON does. Not a message.

invalid.name: top_level_array
invalid.reason: A JSON array at the top level. Every message body is a JSON object.

invalid.name: boolean_value
invalid.reason: Boolean where an integer belongs. No boolean fields exist in version 0.

invalid.name: payment_challenge_unsigned
invalid.reason: Payment challenge without a signature. Payment challenges MUST be signed; a broker MUST NOT pay from one.

invalid.name: payment_challenge_tampered_invoice
invalid.reason: Payment challenge whose invoice was replaced after signing. The signature no longer verifies; this is the invoice-substitution attack the challenge signature exists to defeat.

invalid.name: per_batch_query_unsigned
invalid.reason: Anonymous per_batch query, otherwise complete. A per_batch query MUST carry pubkey and sig so the batch macaroon can be bound to the requester.

invalid.name: peer_list_response_missing_pubkey
invalid.reason: Unsigned peer list response without a pubkey. The signature is optional; the pubkey is REQUIRED either way.

invalid.name: error_missing_pubkey
invalid.reason: Unsigned error without a pubkey. The signature is optional; the pubkey is REQUIRED either way, so a requester is always told which node refused it.

invalid.name: malformed_pubkey
invalid.reason: Pubkey of 60 hex characters rather than 64. A pubkey that is not exactly the stated length MUST be rejected.
